evidence.title: Cult UI – Shadcn UI Components, Blocks & Templates
Cult Pro is going open source | Existing buyers keep access
Cult Pro goes back to its roots: open source | cult ui/pro

name: Cult UI
summary: Free MIT-licensed shadcn/ui component library: 154 animated React components plus blocks, templates and an MCP server.
description: An open-source React component library installed with the shadcn CLI from the @cult-ui registry. 154 animated components are grouped in the docs by job: AI inputs and generative UI (prompt composer, search, dropzone), app and workspace (analytics chart, kanban board, timer), form controls, feedback and status, navigation and overlays, onboarding, buttons, cards, landing page sections, illustrations, device mockups, backgrounds and typography. Older Cult Pro blocks and templates are being open-sourced; AI SDK Agents is a separate paid product by the same author.
contains: 154 animated components, free and MIT licensed
installed with the shadcn CLI from the @cult-ui registry
58 components added in September 2026 (illustrations, device mockups, cards)
docs groups: AI inputs, app and workspace, form controls, feedback, navigation, onboarding, buttons, cards
MCP server so AI agents can search and install components
theming via shadcn/ui CSS variables and Tailwind CSS v4 tokens
